correctness.rationale: For each original cycle vertex and private leaf, minimum weight per pair is one; attaining weight one forces original label ∅ and leaf a singleton. Collecting those original empty vertices gives an independent set I, so total weight ≥2n−|I|≥2n−floor(n/2). Equality forces I maximum; all other original vertices must be nonempty, and their weight-two original/leaf states are precisely (1,1),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2),(12,∅). Consequently nonzero original state multiplicities are w=(2,2,1), while an empty cycle vertex between original states s,t has 1 permissible leaf singleton if both s,t are the same singleton and 2 otherwise. The transfer T_st=g(s,t)w_t is exactly [[2,4,2],[4,2,2],[4,4,2]]. Even C_{2m} has two alternating maximum independent sets and cyclic transfer trace 2tr(T^m); odd C_{2m+1} has 2m+1 maximum independent sets and path transfer (2m+1)(2,2,1)T^m 1. On the color-symmetric sector T becomes [[6,2],[8,2]], eigenvalues 4±2√5, antisymmetric eigenvalue -2. Independent brute force 4^(2n) labelings for n=3 and n=4 yielded (minimum weight,count)=(5,126),(6,152), corroborating original direct verifier output for n up to six. The proof counts named colors, fixed graph labels, and all equality cases; finite enumeration is not used as infinite proof.
